name: Kongou Yamato
source: He enrolls into the academy after discovering that he is royalty of a long forgotten kingdom. His purpose for arriving becomes clear when he discovers that he is the only one capable of lifting a curse placed on the royalty of this country.
translation: He enrolls into the academy after discovering that he is royalty of a long forgotten kingdom. His purpose for arriving becomes clear when he discovers that he is the only one capable of lifting a curse placed on the royalty of this country.
